narrativeProgression.description: Introduction – Mark introduces himself and his foundation.
Background – Explains his musical background, being from Sheffield and living in Berlin.
Early Influences – Talks about early piano lessons, synthesizer music, and bands like Spandau Ballet, Kraftwerk, and Duran Duran.
Dance Music Boom – Recounts the "Summer of Love" and rise of Acid House in 1989, leading to his interest in electronic music production.
Ambient Music Phase – Discusses his exploration of ambient music, being influenced by bands like The Orb, and eventually growing bored with the genre.
Drum & Bass Shift – Explains how he transitioned to making drum & bass music, got a record deal, released albums, and toured Europe.
New Musical Direction – Shares his current focus on a more chilled-out sound with trip hop and ethnic influences.
Moving to Europe – Discusses the interconnectedness of Europe and why he prefers living in Berlin over England.
Berlin & Italy – Talks about his positive experience living in Berlin and his future plans to move to Italy.
Music as a Way of Life – Philosophical insights on music as a full-time profession, the need to make a living, and the accessibility of music creation today.
Music as Literacy – Compares music creation to literacy, highlighting the potential for both positive and negative outcomes due to its widespread accessibility.

scenes.thematicElements: Musical Journey: Mark's evolution as a musician, exploring various genres and finding his niche. Accessibility of Music Creation: The impact of technology on music production and its democratization. Lifestyle and Culture: Preference for a European way of life and its cultural influences.
